cards.title: Core idea
cards.body: Build a home lab once and reuse it for every module: one attacker VM (Kali Linux) and three vulnerable targets (Metasploitable 2, a Windows eval VM, and DVWA in Docker) on an isolated host-only network.

cards.title: How it works
cards.body: Use VirtualBox or VMware as hypervisor; give Kali about 4 GB RAM. Run DVWA with docker run -d -p 8080:80 vulnerables/web-dvwa and check it with curl -I (expect a 302 to /login.php). Confirm Kali can ping the targets and create a notes file with one section per exam domain.

questions.a: To keep vulnerable targets isolated from other networks while the attacker VM can reach them.

questions.q: What should curl -I against DVWA return?

questions.a: Metasploitable 2, a Windows eval VM, and DVWA in Docker.
